oneOf.description: The file was read and applied.

ExchangeFormat.description: The format of an exchanged file (doc 10 §4.1).

ExchangeStamp.description: The stamp of a configuration project's last exchange with PLC software (doc 10 §2.2, §4.2).

direction.description: Whether the file was written or read.

format.description: The format of the exchanged file.

version.description: The format's version ("1.4.0" of AR APC).

FieldGroup.description: A group of exchanged fields with one owner (doc 10 §2.2).

oneOf.description: The start addresses of the modules.
What the PLC software configures: firmware, IP addresses, PROFINET names and DP station addresses.

Ident.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Owner.description: Who owns a field group in an exchange (doc 10 §2.2).

oneOf.description: The schematic: a change of the PLC software is listed and applied only when accepted.
The PLC software: its change is applied, and the field is protected after the first import.
Both: a change of one side applies, a change of both is a conflict.

Ownership.description:
The ownership of a configuration project's exchanged fields (doc 10 §2.2, §3.9, FR-PLC-033): the owner of each
configurable field group, and the protection of the PLC-owned groups.

An older 0.1 build keeps the member verbatim and does not enforce the protection: a PLC-owned field it edits is
an ordinary difference in the next import's three-way merge, so the file stays consistent.

imported.description:
The date of the first applied PLC import: from it on, an edit of a PLC-owned group is refused until
`plc.unlock` lifts the protection. Absent: nothing is protected.

module_starts.description: The owner of the module start addresses; absent: the PLC.

symbols.description: The owner of symbols and comments; absent: shared.

unlocked.description: The groups whose protection `plc.unlock` lifted; the next applied import protects them again.

Sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest sha256:<64 lower-case hex> (doc 05 §3.2).

SourceRef.description:
The import provenance of a record (doc 14 §2.3, ADR-0004 amendment 1): the lineage and the source key
from which the record's ID `v5(lineage namespace, key)` was derived.

key.description: The source key, byte for byte (NFC), such as `qet:el:<uuid>`.

SymbolPolicy.description: How a configuration project derives and validates channel symbols (doc 10 §2.2, §3.4).

strict_iec.description:
Strict IEC 61131-3 identifiers (the default): the automatic symbol is cleaned into one, and EW-PLC-005
reports a symbol that is not one.

tag_table.description: The PLC tag table the symbols are exported to (the TIA "PLC Tags" table name).

template.description:
The template of the automatic symbol (`{target.process_tag|target.dt}`, `{target.dt}_{pin}`); absent: a
channel without a manual symbol has none.

description:
One target PLC-software project (doc 10 §2.2, rank 11, `project.jsonl`): it scopes address and symbol
uniqueness (FR-PLC-002) and pins the address profile that renders every address (FR-PLC-008).

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

cpu.description: The CPU device; absent when the master sits outside the project (Golden A).

exchange.description: The stamp of the last exchange (doc 10 §4.2); its snapshot is in `exchange/<id>.jsonl`.

ownership.description:
Who owns which field group in the exchange with PLC software (doc 10 §2.2, FR-PLC-033); absent: the default
owners and nothing protected.

symbols.description:
The symbol policy (doc 10 §2.2, §3.4, FR-PLC-017, FR-PLC-047); absent: no automatic symbol, strict IEC
identifiers.
